articles.title: GameStop Announces Long-Term Performance Award for Ryan Cohen
articles.mainIdea: GameStop Announces Long-Term Performance Award for Ryan Cohen
articles.summary: Business Wire: GameStop Announces Long-Term Performance Award for Ryan Cohen. GRAPEVINE, Texas, January 07, 2026--GameStop Corp. (NYSE: GME) ("GameStop" or the "Company") today announced that its Board of Directors has granted a performance-based stock option award to Ryan Cohen, the Company’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. The award is designed to incentivize Mr. Cohen to achieve extraordinary growth.
